import unittest
from copy import deepcopy
from solution import select_context


class SelectContextTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_scoring_sorting_exact_tokens_and_deep_copy(self):
        records = [
            {"id": "b", "text": "Alpha beta beta", "metadata": {"tags": ["b"]}},
            {"id": "a", "text": "BETA alpha", "metadata": {"tags": ["a"]}},
            {"id": "c", "text": "alphabet soup", "metadata": {"tags": ["c"]}},
            {"id": "d", "text": "beta", "metadata": {"tags": ["d"]}},
        ]
        original = deepcopy(records)
        result = select_context(records, "ALPHA beta alpha", 3)
        self.assertEqual([(r["id"], r["score"]) for r in result],
                         [("a", 2), ("b", 2), ("d", 1)])
        self.assertEqual(records, original)
        result[0]["metadata"]["tags"].append("changed")
        self.assertEqual(records[1]["metadata"]["tags"], ["a"])

    def test_empty_query_zero_limit_and_no_matches(self):
        records = [{"id": "x", "text": "hello world", "metadata": {}}]
        self.assertEqual(select_context(records, "", 5), [])
        self.assertEqual(select_context(records, "   \t", 5), [])
        self.assertEqual(select_context(records, "hello", 0), [])
        self.assertEqual(select_context(records, "absent", 5), [])
        self.assertEqual(select_context([], "hello", 5), [])

    def test_validates_all_records_on_early_result_cases(self):
        bad_records = [
            {"id": "x", "text": "ok", "metadata": {}},
            {"id": "x", "text": "duplicate", "metadata": {}},
        ]
        for query, limit in (("", 5), ("hello", 0)):
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                select_context(bad_records, query, limit)

    def test_malformed_inputs(self):
        valid = {"id": "x", "text": "text", "metadata": {}}
        bad_records = ["bad", {"id": "x"}, {**valid, "id": ""},
                       {**valid, "text": 1}, {**valid, "metadata": []}]
        for record in bad_records:
            with self.subTest(record=record):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    select_context([record], "q", 1)
        cases = [((), "q", 1), ([valid], None, 1), ([valid], "q", -1),
                 ([valid], "q", True), ([valid], "q", 1.0)]
        for records, query, limit in cases:
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                select_context(records, query, limit)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
